title: Even the Student Council Has its Holes! Anime Casts Yumi Uchiyama
content: The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga revealed the character promotional video, character visual, and cast for the character Satomi Hiratsuka on Saturday.

title: Demon Slayer Shares New Look At The Youngest Hashira Ahead of His Biggest Fight in Infinity Castle
content: After making fans wait for a year, the first installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy finally made its streaming debut across the globe. The film kickstarts the most intense arc in the series, where the Demon Slayers engage in the final battle against the Upper Moons.

title: Maho Ako Launches ‘Utena Eau de Toilette’ — A Fragrance Inspired by Utena Hiiragi
content: Gushing Over Magical Girls’ production company recently announced “Smells Like Baby Spirit”, an eau de toilette inspired by Utena Hiiragi’s scent! The Utena eau de toilette will debut at Maho Ako pop-up shops in Kinshicho and Namba this sunmer. Afterwards, select online retailers will carry the product.

title: PuniRunes Puni 4 Anime Season to Premiere on October 4
content: The official website for the anime of Takara Tomy 's PuniRunes toyline announced on Saturday that the fourth anime season , PuniRunes Puni 4 , will premiere on October 4 at 9:15 a.m. (October 3 at 8:15 p.m. EDT).

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Commences New Arc With Gorgeous First Look
content: Crunchyroll is currently streaming the perfect Solo Leveling replacement for fans awaiting the anime’s return. Solo Leveling has been one of the most successful manhwa and light novel series across the globe, long before the anime was ever confirmed.

title: Muichiro Tokito From Demon Slayer Gets 2026 Birthday Illustration by Ufotable
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba revealed a new 2026 birthday illustration by ufotable to commemorate the birthday of Muichiro Tokito. The Mist Hashira celebrates his birthday on August 8.
